meta.title: Companion Workflow | Immersive Analytics Workspace
meta.description: Four deliberate beats carry an idea from prompt to action.

sections.title: Four deliberate beats carry an idea from prompt to action.
sections.body:
The flow mirrors how analysts actually work—explore, iterate, validate, deliver—while the platform takes care of orchestration.
FastAPI secures access, DuckDB models the data, workers enrich context, and the LLM narrates the story.

items.label: Connect
items.title: Ingest & focus
items.body: Upload datasets or point the companion to authorised sources—files, warehouses, APIs, documented web pages. Metadata is catalogued instantly, and the assistant confirms which signals are ready before moving forward.

items.label: Explore
items.title: LLM pairing
items.body: Describe goals in natural language. Prompt guides draw on past conversations, ensuring the LLM suggests measurable hypotheses—querying datasets, enriching from APIs, or summarising authorised web context.

items.label: Validate
items.title: Interrogate & justify
items.body: Review multi-step analysis plans, generated visuals, and narrative drafts. The assistant explains each decision, proposes alternative slices, and automatically queues workers for deeper exploration or scheduled refreshes.

items.label: Deliver
items.title: Package & broadcast
items.body: Export polished decks, share live dashboards, trigger downstream alerts, or update partner tools. Decision trails and cost summaries stay linked to every hand-off.

sections.title: Automation keeps pace with your curiosity.
sections.body:
FastAPI routes requests to the right services, DuckDB handles transformations in-memory, and workers take on asynchronous enrichment.
Meanwhile the companion narrates impact, suggests follow-ups, and keeps context aligned for your next session.

items.title: Intent-aware routing
items.body: Requests flow through FastAPI services that understand user roles, data sensitivity, and cost constraints before touching any storage or API.

items.title: Edge analytics
items.body: The transformation layer blends files, API payloads, and event streams at lightning speed, powering interactive exploration without round-trips.

items.title: Worker choreography
items.body: Async tasks monitor costs, refresh models, poll authorised APIs, and sync summaries to downstream dashboards—so your focus stays on the storyline.
